notes.title: 2020.3.8 White Release for akeytsu Indie 2021
notes.content:
We deliver a first pass on the Space Switching ie. Dynamic Parenting constraint for akeytsu Indie 2021 right on time before Christmas. This opens up tons of possibilities to create convincing animations featuring a character and an object.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1468090/akeytsu_Indie_2021/

This comes together with a unified timeline experience to facilitate multi-character animation following up on the addition of Cameras in our previous release.

We also updated our akeyboy test character model to give him a modern look and illustrate the use of Space Switching. Sky Surfer also gets a board and a gun that you can play around with as well as a new Sky Jump animation showcasing Space Switching.

Read more about our release highlights on [url=https://www.nukeygara.com/blog/news/2020-3-release-highlights]our website.[/url] Changelist follows.

[b]Note: This release is only available for PC users for now.[/b]

[h1]Summary: Major release
[/h1]

[h2]Features[/h2]

[h3]Added Space Switching ie. Dynamic Parenting constraint (Beta)[/h3]
[list]
[*]  [Picker] Click chain icon opposite to joint names to define them as possible space
[*] [Mixer] Create Space Switching layer
[*] When creating a key on a Space Switching layer, prompts a dialog to define new space
[/list]

[h2]Enhancements[/h2]

[h3][Timebar] New "Unified timelines" option in Timebar preferences[/h3]
[list]
[*] Time cursor now keeps same time code when browsing through animations/characters
[*] Time cursors now stops/plays without resetting to previously selected key 
[/list]

[h2]Refinements[/h2]
[list]
[*] [Timebar and MixerDialog] Changed and unified stacker colors
[*] [Test Characters] Akeyboy V2 with new modelization, basic face rig and space-switched skateboard
[*] [Test Characters] Added gun and flying board props and Sky Jump animation to Sky Surfer
[/list]

[h1]Revamped Free Characters[/h1]

We have more gifts for you with two revamped models that were introduced in 2020.3 and made available in akeytsu Indie 2020 & 2021.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35544836/ac5bd246246ed91a197a87d42dc3659d6160e255.png[/img]

Akeyboy V2 got a considerable update. We've remodelled the character with a fresh and modern look. We have included low-resolution textures in our installation package to keep things light but PBR versions can be downloaded from our Free Characters page. Looking at the rig, we have reworked the position of joints and pivot orientations for the skeleton and reskinned everything for improved Move, Rotate and Scale transforms and added a basic facial rig that you can draw your inspiration from for your own cahracters. Taking advantage of Space Switching ie. Dynamic Parenting we have also updated animations with skateboard to show you how it should be done.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35544836/db5312cb4eb3943547d41db3fb0027293649677e.png[/img]

On the other hand Sky Surfer is getting new toys for Christmas and can now play with a skysurf and a gun. A Jump Trick sample animation is provided here too so that you can see how to correctly build an animation with a Space Switching layer. PBR textures are downloadable from our Free Characters page.

[h1]2020 Quick Recap[/h1]

2020 was again a year filled with many updates to turn aeytsu into the ideal 3D animation tool for Indies and mid-sized studios. In a nutshell, updates included biped Auto Rig, Cameras, Retargeting, Screen Space, Sticky Aim, Space Switching ie. Dynamic Parenting, Audio support, FBX compatibility fixes, BVH importer and many quality-of-life improvements and enhancements to already-existing features.

If you'd like to read on what you have missed out this year, Release Highlight articles are listed below:

[url=https://www.nukeygara.com/blog/news/2020-1-release-highlights]Read about 2020.1 Release Highlights[/url]
[url=https://www.nukeygara.com/blog/news/2020-2-release-highlights]Read about 2020.2 Release Highlights[/url]
[url=https://www.nukeygara.com/blog/news/2020-3-release-highlights]Read about 2020.3 Release Highlights[/url]

[h1]Final Words[/h1]

The whole Nukeygara team wishes you a Merry Christmas and a happy New Year. The team will get back at work in 2021 after much needed winter holidays.

Stay safe and healthy everyone, much is already in the works to let you animate even more in akeytsu next year !

notes.title: Clarifying akeytsu Indie 2021 release
notes.content:
Hi all,

This post will attempt to clarify all questions related to the upcoming introduction of akeytsu Indie 2021 and the release of our last major update this year. Although things are not set in stone for 2021 and we have no definite roadmap for that year it will also touch on the main development areas, how we'll go about running this devs and perhaps most importantly for the community how we'll communicate on our progress.

[h1]2020.3 Major Update[/h1]

We are currently all hands on deck to get version 2020.3 released by end of the month. Believe us when we say no time is spared to make this happen and it isn’t short of challenges.

Contrary to what was highlighted on the shop presentation page at some point [b]it was decided that all 2020.3.X updates will be made available to akeytsu Indie 2020 users[/b] to reward early adopters for upgrading from akeytsu Indie 2017, ease the transition to an annual release and make up for what some, and for the right reasons, saw as a lack of proper communication on our side.

Feature-wise our priorities are to ship
[list][*] Space Switching (Dynamic Parenting) which will enable an object to change space across a single animation and will let you animate character props with a lot more ease by binding it to world or a joint of interest such as a given hand in the case of a weapon.
[*] What’s internally known at Nukeygara as Global IK which will provide you with an additional tool to better manage the behavior of a given IK-chain across multiple layers and let you decide whether IK should have priority over certain layers or the opposite.[/list]

[b]Both these features are highly technical and require us, at a very low level in the code, to augment our engine with new concepts or protocols to keep akeytsu the way it is: simple and user-friendly.[/b] It's often hard to grasp but some of akeytsu most potent innovations are hidden under-the-hood so that the user doesn't have to worry about it

This requires us to consider a great number of use cases so that everything works like a charm. For this reason we've decided to postpone some of what was announced on the roadmap to a later date namely Looker, Roll joints and Meta-controllers (although no one really knows what these are at this point because it's our little secret).

Some of these may or may not come by end of this year at which point they'll be patched as a 2020.3.X update. [b]We want to reassure you that we are not holding on to anything that’s ready for obscure reasons. If anything we are actually developing "just-in-time” to make the most of it. [/b] And this of course, as some of you know, can be a lot of stress on a dev team.

[h1]akeytsu Indie 2021[/h1]

The akeytsu Indie 2021 product will be released on Steam together with 2020.3 with exactly the same price as akeytsu Indie 2017 (now delisted) and 2020. This product will be patched with 2021 updates until akeytsu Indie 2022 releases end of next year.

[b]A loyalty offer to upgrade from akeytsu Indie 2020 to 2021 will be put in place as soon as possible.[/b] Please bear in mind that COVID-19 has slowed down operations for a lot of people including Valve so this may take a bit of time but will be arranged eventually.

[b]More importantly there will be opportunities to upgrade from 2017 to 2020 and 2020 to 2021 at discounted price during either or both Autumn and Winter sales depending on how fast all can be set up.[/b] There will be no direct bridge from akeytsu Indie 2017 to 2020. I'm not at liberty to tell discount rates and exact dates for these sales according to Valve policies but be on the look-out for them. Every user counts and we want you guys to embark on a journey with us. Patience is a virtue and those who bear with us will be rewarded.

[b]In terms of content, our roadmap for 2021 will be available by beginning of next year and while it's too soon to get into specifics I can already tell you a little more about what's currently brewing in our minds.[/b] Obviously one thing we want to offer is more “smart” constraints just like we have for IK and RF. We want to improve in-app discovery and accessibility to reduce friction when switching over from another app. We'd also like to facilitate the import and tweaking of mocap assets in akeytsu while staying true to our keyframing spirit. Finally we want to add more interface options to make akeytsu even more relevant for professional use.

Feel free to discuss these in the comment as we ARE reading everything and hear your concerns although we don't always answer.

[h1]Roamdap, Community & Communication[/h1]

We have also noticed that the way we built our roadmap did not let us have enough maneuverability with development and created frustrations among users for wrong reasons. While we absolutely want to bring in more into akeytsu we need to be able to pilot either time, content or quality. [b]Quality is not an option for us as our basic promise is – simply put – “to do it better”.[/b] The way we wrote our 2020 roadmap was interpreted as a full-on commitment on both content and time.

From that point onwards we kind of brought doom on ourselves for the whole of 2020 as it always turns out to be a steeper slope to climb when you start climbing. We are still proud and satisfied, in that turn of event, to be in a position where we should deliver 80% of what was initially written with 2020.3 on a modest team (of remarkably skilled and passionate people) compared to other big players. Of course, we'll keep on aiming for 100% and will get better at it with more time and experience.

We understand that people are expecting a lot of akeytsu. If anything that's kind of a good sign. We also appreciate that one needs visibility if one is going to purchase based on the promise of future updates. [b]We'll still plan for several major updates next year that we will let you know about in the form of a roadmap as soon as things are better shaped out.[/b]

That being said and in order to keep things manageable internally, we’ll change the way we design our roadmap along with production methods. [b]For each update package, our 2021 roadmap will sanctify one Feature that will be our absolute priority.[/b] And while we’ll still have internal launch windows for each version, we will refrain from sharing them so as to not be deceptive when we have to postpone by a week or so to make sure it's ready.

Finally there will be a list of Feature Candidates that will be shared along Priority Features. These Feature Candidates may or may not find their way into akeytsu Indie 2021 depending on production impediments BUT we'll aim for roughly 70% of it to be delivered before akeytsu Indie 2021 launches on Steam.

[h1]Final words[/h1]

We think that this is the best compromise we can offer and we hope that you'll find it agreeable. [b]Feel free to let us know your thoughts and list what you’d like to see put as Priority Features or Feature Candidates.[/b] More than anything we hope that you'll be willing to keep on animating in akeytsu and help us build a tool that will unleash both aspiring and savvy animators. Feel free to share 

We wish you the best in these very challenging times,
- The Nukeygara Team

notes.title: October Update 2019.3 now available for akeytsu Indie 2020!
notes.content:
In October you may want to put on a few additional layers and take care of your skin before stepping outside. Lucky you ! Nukeyuara developers are here to help you do just that. 

Discover the highlights of our 2019 October release on http://bit.ly/2pMBida. Changelist follows.

[b]Note: This release is only available for PC for now. macOS update will follow shortly.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1125100/akeytsu_Indie_2020/

[b]Features [/b]
[list]
[*] Additive layers are now implemented*
[*] Geodesic voxels are now used to calculate binding weights 
[*] Reverse Foot Snap or Align: Snap your RF controller to foot sole or align it horizontally while preserving your pose (available in Spinner RF mode)
[*] Added Stepped Interpolation to Curveboard*
[*] [Settings] Added Playback speed in Timeline preferences*
[*] [Settings] Added Back-face culling option in 3D rendering preferences*
[*] [UI] Added Hide HUD option in Layout and Render window*
[*] [Selection] Right-click menu on Skin Atelier influences now exposes “Select vertices influenced by all selected influences"
[/list]

[b]Enhancements[/b]
[list]
[*] [3D view] Upgrade to OpenGL 3.1
[*] [Skinning] Simplified workflow to directly access Step 2 of Duo Skin and smooth influences*
[*] [UX] Spinner Move Rotate Scale (MRS) rework
[*] Better MRS behavior when handling a skeleton with non-uniform scaled joints
[*] MRS Gizmo is not degenerated anymore when handling a skeleton with non-uniform scaled joints
[*] Refined “Compensate Scale“ behavior
[*] Finer and more accurate edition of intermediary layers
[*] [UX] New keyboard shortcut options to edit text/value strings
[*] Ctrl + right/left allows you to browse strings within a given window panel
[*] Up/down arrow lets you go at the beginning/end of the string
[*] [UI] Weight pad has been deleted from Skin Atelier
[*] [Virtual keys] Major low-level code overhaul to prepare implementation of to-be-released animation keys (blendshapes, cameras...)
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Character is not renamed anymore after Updating Skinned Mesh
[*] [Export] Several folders can now be handled when exporting to AKNM
[*] [UI] Gizmo is not hidden anymore when using “Hide All“ in Tree
[*] Keys cannot be created in Skin&Check mode anymore
[/list]

[b]Crash fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Crash fixed when skinning a mesh with hidden vertices
[*] Loading a mesh with no material array is now possible
[/list]

*Inspired by community feedback

notes.title: September Update now available for akeytsu Indie 2020
notes.content:
Autumn is at our doorsteps and for akeytsu users it comes with an apple on top of many grapes that the Nukeygara team has nurtured through summer. The macOS version should be available shortly on Steam as well.

Changelist follows. Discover the highlights of our 2019 September release on https://bit.ly/2kT1DE2

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Custom leg joint chain for Reverse Foot
[*] Update Skinned Mesh : replaces skinned mesh by unbound mesh and transfers skinning data
[*] Smart Pivot Reorientation: pivot orientations are recomputed in animation mode according to how they are edited in Bind Pose
[*] .obj and .dae (Collada) formats can now be imported
[*] Target size now customizable for each Inverse Kinematics/Reverse foot handle
[/list]


[b]Enhancements[/b]
[list]
[*] Display: OS-Driven High Resolution management
[*] Settings: Exposed a “quality vs performances” Rendering preference to let user choose between Fast/Balanced/Beautiful rendering (PC only, still in test for macOS)
[*] UI: Skin Atelier panel now split between Painter panel with skinning brush tools and lighter Skin Atelier window
[*] Controls: Added middle and right-click behavior on transform channel checkboxes and master checks
[*] Misc: Default save path now set to loading directory. Similarly, export FBX save path is now set to the directory of the imported FBX file & the same goes for AKNM paths
[*] Misc: Logged an error message when Cycle Side fails due to an odd number of keys
[*] UI: Removed vertical bar on the left of Tree and the Preferences panels to save space
[/list]


[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Toggling ghosting on/off with shortcut now works even when not on a key
[*] Brush paint: brush does not paint hidden vertices anymore
[*] Fixed weight removal with brush when a mesh is not "Reset&Freezed"
[*] Smooth skinning: better behavior when skinning “umbrella-like” meshes
[*] Mirror Skin and Mirror Skeleton now consider joint sides from Bind Pose (previously from Check Pose)
[*] Improved display order of Gizmo axis in specific cases
[*] Timeline tick marks now match keys when animating at 24 fps
[*] Timeline does not display a given tick mark several times anymore
[*] Restored gizmo highlight when spinner is hovered on in paint mode
[*] Fixed IK/RF right-click bug when click was interpreted as a rotate ball selection
[*] In BindPose, skeleton scale does not lead to skinned meshes geometry transformations anymore
[*] In BindPose, changing the CompensateScale mode of a joint does not modify Skinned Mesh geometry anymore
[*] Character scale and root joint CompensateScale: in BindPose, mesh geometry is not impacted by joint scales anymore
[*] Fixed vertex normals import/export problem (W = 1): normalized vertex normal at import and mesh Reset&Freeze won’t consider translations for vertex normals anymore
[/list]


[b]Crash fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Bind skin: Crash fixed when the character is under a mesh to bind
[*] Mirror skin and joint: Crash fixed when no skinning has been done
[*] Copy skin: Crash fixed when another mesh is selected while a Copy Skin vertex selection is active
[/list]

notes.title: Akeytsu 1.2.0 available
notes.content:
Hi Akeytsu friends,

We hope you are all fine (surely preparing Halloween ;-)).
Here in Lyon, our team stays focused on V2 features. However we don't forget you so please find a new version of Akeytsu.
Enjoy... and happy Halloween ;-)

[b]Version 1.2.0[/b]
[h1]Enhancements[/h1]
- IK and Reverse Foot rework
---- More stable
---- More accurate
---- Transform actions more accurate
---- Backward compatibility (ability to reload old files containing RF)
- In BindPose/RefPose, when you move an ancestor of an IK/RF string, IK/RF controller is now moved relatively
- Meshes are now optimized at import and file loading
- Tree: When a character has no more joint, his meshes are unskinned
- Skin Atelier: Removed 0. step in weight spinner, restored weight edition with weight buttons
- Added selection "Descendants Only" on Middle Mouse Button click (useful to quickly select all fingers!)
- Added display preferences, added setting "Show Decorators affects all views"
- Added shortcut to Show/Hide selected objects (press H)
- Added 64 bits PNG texture support by converting to 32 bits
- Rounded values at FBX export
- Added version number under top Main menu logo

[h1]Crash Fixes[/h1]
- Fixed a crash when a mesh is imported without vertex
- Fixed a crash with a Dual screen config, when rectangle selection bottom right corner was outside the main screen


[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
- Curveboard: The curves are now also auto-focused if the user selects an IK/RF (not just a joint)
- Fixed unique name for characters
- Fixed UVs, normals, colors export

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26288417/8bd74a3df4010ec34a056e62779d0256e7d3c3aa.png[/img]

Hi Akeytsu folks!
We hope you are well. While our team is focusing on V2 features (including tasty blendshapes :-)) we do not forget you for all that.
So here's Update 1.1.0 with the very nice "Hide Skinned Mesh Vertices" allowing, f.i, to hide the empty side of your model when working your half skin, to work your skin from the inside! Vertex lasso (and ability to select front only vertices) included too.
Enjoy ;-)

[b]Version 1.1.0 [2018/05/21][/b]
[h1]Features[/h1]
-Hide Skinned Mesh Vertices (new command in Skin Atelier)
-Vertex Lasso Selection (available on mouse middle button in Rigging Part)
    Hand-draw a closed figure (one single "click'n'drag" or several "clicks'n'drag")
-Ability to select front vertex only (pick/rectangle/lasso)

[h1]Enhancements[/h1]
-Unified selection “Full Paint mode“: now available for Painter action and selection, vertex rectangle selection and lasso selection
-Added/Modified cursor for vertices selection
-The "+" button on the numpad expands the selection in a classic way ; no more ring stuff 
-Back of the scene characters are now lighted
-Curveboard: AutoFocus when the user starts a joint selection. Autofocus when the user hides or shows channel.
-LogProgressManager now also updates the Windows taskbar 
-FBX: Optimized Uvs, Normals and Colors imports
-Added scale display (disabled) in Transform window in Default and Bind Pose 
-Allowed MRS transformations on meshes in Animation mode
-Akeytsu installer now installs VC Redistributable vcredist2013 and vcredist2015
-Tweaked the red, green, blue and orange colors of Akeytsu UI

[h1]Crash Fixes[/h1]
-Fixed crash when pasting (transform) without animation (button was not supposed to be active in this case)
-Fixed crash when reorienting with non controllers under joints
-Fixed crash when autosave folder was not writable

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
-FBX: Fixed materials export
-Fixed timeline bug (cursor frame index)
-Various bug fixes (DropList rendering, crash on IK deletion, Import freeze, curveboard crash, etc.)

notes.title: Akeytsu 1.0 is now available for you!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26288417/8999d13e5b8e315146173cef61985eed52da6d17.png[/img]

Including:

[u] New Features [/u]

One-click FK/IK Reverse Foot (on a single skeleton)
New skinning workflow
New poses system  
Animation conversion (after Ref Pose changed)
Totally New UI ( flat)
Sketchfab Integration

Multi bind poses
o For FBX imported with several bind poses we keep only the one which influences most points
o Same for AKT with several bind poses

Export FBX
o	ASCII
o	Embed Media option
o	Selective
o	Character position

Frame rate management
o	Animation resampling

Extended ways to open/import files in Akeytsu
o	Drag and Drop on Akeytsu window
o	Double click on Akeytsu files (FBX or AKT). Open a new Window or use existing window
o	Drag and Drop on Akeytsu .exe 

Spinner
o	Move + rotate combo mode
o	Rotate ball on MMB

Miscellaneous
o	Center joints on vertex selection
o	Joints only mirroring
o	Skinned mesh lock
o	Gizmo 3D move plan and snap
o	Mesh reset and freeze

[u] Enhancements [/u]

Increase Curveboard performances
Allowed Scale in Rigging mode when selection is composed of non-skinned meshes
IK Controller pole angle data are now cached and displayed
AKNM export and import through the Anim bank ( addition of softer name matching and animation selection) 
The Spinner and the Gizmo are now activated when needed 
Deleted default character after import (if empty)
FBX Import
      o	Fixed FBX import transformation problems
      o	Improved management of the missing properties of materials
      o	Not supported 3D nodes are now imported as dummies
When creating an animation, we don't rename immediately the animation
It's no possible anymore to rename an item with only space character


[u] Crash Fixes [/u]

Fixed graphic cards crashes
Import multiple characters
Akeytsu stacker stuff (Create, Extract, Hammer) doesn’t crash anymore

[u] Bug Fixes [/u]

IK with Layer now works correctly
License management no longer loops on some Windows versions
Updated ghost positions when character is moved during animation
When we parent a joint under a character, this one is now seen by the character (=>Picker is now updated)
It’s now possible to add/remove hammer from the picker if object is not selected
Textures and material are not copied anymore when imported

Enjoy!
The Nukeygara Team

notes.title: Update 3.6.4 now available
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26288417/99ffdbfbf8d8f725a5c36c37d5e7ceb85f546546.png[/img]

Hi Akeytsu friends, 

How is your summer? Sunny & Hot🌞? 
Well, ours is steaming as all the team is working hard for you, focusing and running toward V1 release this fall. 
However before delivering it, [b]here is our last update prior to V1[/b] including the awaited Copy Skin feature 😊. Also included, some Unity and UE4 skeleton templates helping newcomers to rig even more easily their character and exchange data fluently with their preferred game engine. And as usual, few bug fixes. This is it for the starter guys and we keep cooking the main course for Akeytsu V1😎

Concerning Copy/Paste Skin feature or Unity3D and UE4 skeleton samples, please visit our new « How to » section, available on Nukeygara wiki to quickly discover how to use them …
[url]https://nukeygara.atlassian.net/wiki/display/AUG/How+to[/url]

Enjoy your summer, enjoy Akeytsu and stay tuned!

[b]New Features[/b]
- Copy/Paste Skin
- UE4 and Unity skeleton samples 

[b]Improvements[/b]
- Option to hide 3D manipulator if skin painter is active (excepted if mouse is above the Spinner) 

[b]Crash fixes[/b]
- License management looped on some Windows versions
- Selecting a non skinned mesh and joints, then editing a channel in the Transform window led to a crash 

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
- CycleMaker does not offset anymore a non-tagged joint child of tagged one (tagged means has "_L"-like suffix) 
- No more shader codeline leading to a shader compilation error on old Intel drivers

- Paint Remove and Paint Target (re)work correctly if weight was 1.0

notes.title: Update 3.5 now available

•  When opening non-akt file with Open Scene...
•  When clicking on Stacker/Select All Keys or Half-Keys without stacker (empty scene).
•  When creating a joint without Character in the current scene
 
Bug Fixes
•  The undo submenu entries were without effect, now they undo again. 
•  Press Alt key alone does not anymore freeze akeytsu until next interaction
•  Fbx Import with skinned mesh pivots not in 0,0,0 works now correctly

Enjoy it !
